lines: Hello, everyone!
大家好！
My name is Jonathan.
我叫 Jonathan。
I am a little host of Shenzhen.
我是深圳小主人。
Welcome to Shenzhen for APEC!
欢迎来深圳参加 APEC！
Today, let me show you the tallest building in Shenzhen.
今天，我带大家看看深圳最高的楼。
This is Ping An Finance Center.
这就是平安金融中心——平安大厦。
It is in Futian, in the heart of Shenzhen.
它在福田，就在深圳的市中心。
Ping An means safe and peaceful in Chinese.
“平安”在中文里是平平安安的意思。
How tall is it?
它有多高呢？
It is five hundred and ninety-nine meters tall!
它有 599 米高！
It has one hundred and fifteen floors.
它有 115 层。
Wow, that is so, so tall!
哇，真的好高好高！
Look up! It is shiny and silver.
抬头看！它亮晶晶的，是银色的。
It looks like a giant rocket, ready to fly into the sky!
它像一枚大火箭，准备飞上天空！
We can take a super fast elevator to the top.
我们可以坐超快的电梯到楼顶。
From the sky deck, I can see the whole city.
在观光层，我能看到整座城市。
The cars look like tiny toys!
汽车看起来像小玩具一样！
At night, Shenzhen lights up.
到了晚上，深圳亮起来了。
The buildings shine like stars.
大楼像星星一样闪闪发光。
Shenzhen is a young city.
深圳是一座年轻的城市。
It is green, it is smart, and it is full of technology.
它很绿色，很智慧，充满了科技。
My city is growing fast, just like me!
我的城市长得很快，就像我一样！
Friends from APEC, welcome to Shenzhen!
APEC 的朋友们，欢迎来深圳！
Come and see the tallest building with me!
快来和我一起看最高的楼吧！
Thank you! Bye-bye!
谢谢大家！再见！
